==Description==
'''M-120''', or "Mimicry" is the fourth entity you will encounter within the M-Section. It was added a little later after [[M-70]]'s addition, and it possesses a unique ability to mimic other entities and their behaviors, specifically from previous sections, making it the most unique counterpart of the said [[A-120|entity]]. More information about '''M-120''' will be presented below.

==Behavior==
Upon spawning, '''M-120''' will manifest at middle of the current room from the door label. After it has fully formed, it will wait a few seconds before rushing backwards. Upon reaching the void wall, '''M-120''' will make drumming sounds, then it will mimic the oldest behavior(for most) of one of the eight entities that appear down below at Mimics.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''M-120's''' [[A-20]] mimic, or '''20-A''', will rush from behind [[Void]]'s claim wall and rush to the current room while emitting brief distorted whooshing noises. Despite [[A-20]] slowing down, '''20-A''' will not, which makes it a bigger threat compared to other [[Entities|entities]], considering its moderately fast speed and high damage rate. '''20-A''' will despawn as soon as it reaches the latest door generated.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''M-120's''' [[A-60]] mimic, or '''60-A''', will rush from a point, similarly to [[A-60]]. It will rush to the current room while emitting soft static noises and instantly killing any player in sight, and it will emit another higher-pitched static sound in proximity. '''60-A''' will instantly despawn the moment it reaches the latest door generated. Additionally, it will also smash the door, similarly to [[M-60]], having a chance of spawning [[M-150]], [[M-200]], or another '''M-120'''.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''M-120's''' [[A-85]] mimic, or '''85-A''', will pivot itself similarly to [[A-85]] itself, being just in front of the door. It will play loud distorted static sounds. After several seconds, '''85-A''' will then rush backwards, rapidly damaging anyone in sight until they are dead. Its destination is '''M-120's''' mimic point, where it will then despawn upon '''85-A''' reaching it.

<h2> Trivia </h2>
* Unlike most mimics, '''M-120''' does not mimic [[A-85]]'s oldest behavior.
** this is also the case for '''M-120's''' [[D-5]] mimic.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''M-120's''' [[D-5]] mimic, or '''5-D''', will pivot itself similarly to [[A-120]] and/or [[A-135]]. It will play an explosion sound and fill anyone's screen with static. The static will fade out, almost as if it were a countdown. After the static completely fades out, '''5-D''' will begin rushing back to '''M-120's''' mimic point, where it will then play a random despawn sound that resembles [[D-5]]'s oldest despawning sound.

<h2> Trivia </h2>
* Unlike most mimics, '''M-120''' does not mimic [[D-5]]'s oldest behavior.
** this is also the case for '''M-120's''' [[A-85]] mimic.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''M-120's''' [[D-20]] mimic, or '''20-D''', will pivot itself similarly to M-120 itself, where it will emit the same particles as it alongside a light, where it will then reveal itself after a few seconds. After this, '''20-D''' will remain idle in the room, dealing rapid damage to anyone walking nearby. Overtime, '''20-D''' will decay in its face brightness and light brightness, alongside its damage. Eventually, '''20-D''' will completely disappear, leading to its despawn. Unlike [[D-20]], however, it cannot be killed by any weapon, as bullets will just phase through it (this will be changed)

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''M-120's''' [[D-35]] mimic, or '''35-D''', will pivot itself similarly to [[A-60]]. It will make a boom sound(too far away, inaudible in Section M), then rush to the current room while killing any players in sight, having a 10% ''<u>(or 100% depending on if you're in [[Red Rooms]])</u>'' chance to resemble its i-variant, being much faster than before. Upon reaching the current room, '''35-D''' will despawn, and hit the door or completely smash it depending on its speed. If it breaks down the door, it may spawn [[M-150]], [[M-200]], or another '''M-120'''.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''M-120's''' mimic, or '''55-D''', will pivot itself similarly to [[A-60]] and/or [[D-55]] itself. '''55-D''' will begin to rush to the current room, making noises similar to the base entity its mimicking. Upon reaching the current room, '''55-D''' will begin checking every '''Heavy Locker''' in the room, similarly to [[A-135]], but slightly faster, having a 10% ''<u>(50% in [[Red Rooms]])</u>'' chance to break one. After '''55-D''' has finished checking lockers, it will then go back to its spawning point, where it will then despawn.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* As mentioned, '''M-120''' cannot snipe, so use this as your advantage in case '''M-120''' spawns with other entity.
* [[M-200]] & [[M-150]] can't spawn while '''M-120''' is active, but [[M-150]] can spawn together with '''M-120''' if both spawn in the same room, so look for blue light/white light when '''M-120''' spawns.
*'''M-120'''<nowiki/>'s '''35-D''' mimic can ambush and instantly rush to the main room at a very high speed, so if you hear '''35-'''<nowiki/>'''D''''s sound, avoid hiding in blue lockers because if it destroy the door can spawn [[M-200]].
* If you shoot the door label while '''M-120''' is transforming, you can neutralize/despawn it by making the door label break. However this only works with normal weapons, so Perfectionists won't work.
* If '''M-120''' isn't in its '''135-A''' or '''55-D''' mimic, hide in heavy lockers, as other mimics could break the door, spawning [[M-200]].
* If '''M-120''' is in its '''20-D''' mimic, use it to your advantage by going past it while it is transforming and going through doors, as [[M-150]] and [[M-200]] cannot spawn while it is active. 

== Trivia ==
* Not to be confused with '''M-120''' From Interminable Rooms due to having the same name.
* '''20-A, 85-A''' and '''35-D''' cannot kill you if you are under a table. Other mimics however ('''60-A''', '''135-A''', '''5-D''', '''20-D''' and '''55-D''') can still kill you while under them.
* Shooting '''M-120'''<nowiki/>'s door label enough times will make it transform from the previous room's door label.
** Shooting it even more when '''M-120''' is transforming from the previous room's door label will make it transform from a door label that's one room further away.
* If [[M-70]] is active while '''M-120''' is about to mimic, it will wait for [[M-70]] to despawn then transform into a mimic.
* '''M-120''' had a bug for a long time where when it was in its '''135-A''' or '''55-D''' mimic wouldn't kill you in the locker it was checking, however this has been fixed on 2/28/26, so now you can't hide in any locker for '''135-A''' or '''55-D'''.
